title: City S air purifier
description: CITY S air purifier with HEPA H14 and activated carbon filters — a compact solution for homes, offices, schools and public buildings.
paragraphs: CITY S is an air purifier equipped with efficient HEPA and activated carbon filters. Each HEPA filter includes an individual scan test that complies with EN 1822 and serves as proof of H14 filtration efficiency.

sections.title: Why choose City S?
paragraphs: The filters ensure that the CITY S air purifier effectively reduces harmful particles, odours and other volatile organic compounds commonly found in indoor air in homes, offices, schools, hospitals, sports halls and other public buildings.

sections.title: Air quality benefits of purifying with City S
paragraphs: Compared with products available on the market, the filtration area of the filters used in the CITY S unit can be up to 14 times larger than filters from other manufacturers. This provides a longer filter service life and dust holding capacity without reducing airflow. CITY S is equipped with high-efficiency HEPA H14 filters that remove up to 99.995% of MPPS (the most penetrating particle size), ranging from 0.1 to 0.25 microns. Clean air, free from harmful particles and pollutants, is dispersed 360 degrees.

sections.title: Why HEPA molecular filtration?
paragraphs: HEPA filters belong to the so-called “absolute” purification filter category. This term confirms their high filtration efficiency. The City S air purifier is equipped with two combined HEPA H14 and carbon filters that capture both particulate matter and volatile organic compounds in the air. HEPA H14 filter efficiency is 99.995%, calculated by MPPS density. The activated carbon filter removes odours and gases using RAD (rapid adsorption dynamics) properties. Every Camfil HEPA filter is manufactured and tested according to EN 1822, which certifies filter efficiency. Activated carbon filters are manufactured in accordance with ISO 10121.
